answer: One concrete defense is to anchor every agent identity to a scarce, slashable stake. Picture a wharf where each docking slot costs real collateral: spinning up a thousand fake boats becomes ruinous, since every slot is paid for and forfeited on misbehavior. The private secret binding an identity stays hard as a walnut shell, so no single operator can cheaply mint a sybil swarm to outvote or outnumber honest peers.
